SOM.note: No rule or authority on AI harms is stated.
The AI tool is a disaster early-warning system, a sector tool, not general administration.

facts.fact: Diginomica reports that the Shaqodoon Organization's AI-enhanced Saadaal early-warning system, rolled out in April 2024, runs weather and historical data through an AI agent to produce reports for the Ministry of Humanitarian Affairs and Disaster Management in a south-western state, which sends toll-free voice alerts to communities and farmers.

SOM.note: The AI enhancement was built with pro bono private-sector engineers of an accelerator; no local model, dataset or AI computing is stated.
